diundecyl ketone.translation: [化] 双十一基酮; 双十一基甲酮; 12-廿三烷酮

diurbital.translation: [医] 狄尤比妥(血管舒张药、利尿药和镇静药的混合剂)

diurea.translation: [化] 双脲; 环二脲; 四氮杂己环对二酮

diureide.definition:
n. One of a series of complex nitrogenous substances
   regarded as containing two molecules of urea or their radicals, as uric
   acid or allantoin. Cf. Ureide.

diureses.translation:
pl. 利尿, 多尿
[医] 利尿, 多尿

diuresis.definition: n. increased secretion of urine; if not due to increased liquid intake or to the action of a diuretic drug it can be a symptom of diabetes mellitus
diuresis.translation:
n. 利尿, 多尿
[医] 利尿, 多尿

diuretic.definition: n any substance that tends to increase the flow of urine, which causes the body to get rid of excess water
diuretic.translation:
n. 利尿剂
a. 利尿的

diuretic salt.translation: [医] 利尿盐, 醋酸钾, 乙酸钾

diureticalness.definition: n. The quality of being diuretical; diuretic property.

diuretics.definition:
plural of diuretic
n any substance that tends to increase the flow of urine, which causes the body to get rid of excess water
diuretics.translation:
(diuretic 的复数) n. 利尿剂
a. 利尿的

diuretin.translation: [医] 利尿素, 水杨酸钠可可[豆]硷

diuril.definition: n a diuretic drug (trade name Diuril) used in the treatment of edema and hypertension

diurnal.definition:
a. of or belonging to or active during the day
s. having a daily cycle or occurring every day
diurnal.translation:
a. 每日的, 一日间的, 白天的
[医] 昼现的(丝虫), 昼间的

diurnal variation.translation: 昼夜变异，日变程，日变化

diurnalness.definition: n. The quality of being diurnal.

diurnation.definition:
n. Continuance during the day.
n. The condition of sleeping or becoming dormant by day,
   as is the case of the bats.
diurnation.translation: n. 昼间不活动的习性

diuron.translation: n. [化]敌草隆(一种剧毒性除草剂)
